--a R. of the केतुमाल country. वा. ४४. १८.
(I)--a R. in the केतुमाल continent. M. ४४. १८.

-१०; 7-१०.
A वैष्णव क्षेत्र with शिव सान्निध्यम्। Prayers of ब्रह्मा, to लक्ष्मी and विष्णु requested to reside here. Here were celebrated. शिव's marriage, Brahma's with वाणी, and विष्णु with कमला. But ब्रह्मा subsequently left this.
